text: The file has data.users. Count the users that are active (active is true) and whose email is not null/missing and ends with "@example.com", compared case-insensitively. Return a number.
Take users in data.users having a role equal to "admin" (case-insensitive) in their roles array. Return an array of their name strings, exactly as stored, sorted ascending by lowercase name.
Count users in data.users per profile.country. Users with no profile, or a null/missing country, are counted under the key "unknown". Return an object mapping country to count.
Compute the average of profile.age over users in data.users that have a non-null age (ignore users with missing profile or null/missing age). Round to 2 decimal places. Return a number.
Considering only issues with state "open", collect all label names, lowercase them, remove duplicates, and sort ascending alphabetically. Return an array of strings.

Among all issues (any state), take the top 3 by comments descending; ties are broken by number ascending. Return an array of objects {"number": <number>, "assignee": <assignee login string, or null if assignee is null or missing>} in that order.
Count open issues per assignee login. Issues with null or missing assignee are excluded. Return an object mapping login to count.

Merge the dependencies and devDependencies objects. Select entries whose version string starts with "^". Return an array of strings of the form "name@version" (version including the caret), sorted ascending by name.

Take the services array. Keep services where enabled is true (missing enabled counts as false) and port is greater than 8000 (strictly). Return a single string: their names lowercased, sorted ascending, joined with a comma and no spaces.

Each line is: timestamp, level, service, free text. Count lines with level ERROR per service (the third whitespace-separated token). Return an object mapping service to count, only for services with at least one ERROR.
Some lines contain a token "ms=<integer>". Compute the average of those integers over lines that have the token (lines without it are ignored). Round to 1 decimal place. Return a number.

CSV with a header row; columns id,customer,product,qty,price,status. Compute total revenue = sum of qty*price over rows whose status equals "shipped" case-insensitively. Rows with an empty price are skipped. Round to 2 decimal places. Return a number.

Ignoring rows with status "cancelled" (case-insensitive) and rows with an empty price, compute total spend (qty*price) per customer. Return the top 2 customers as an array of {"customer": <name>, "total": <total rounded to 2 decimals>}, sorted by total descending.

Given the word list ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"]: lowercase every word, remove duplicates, sort by length descending then alphabetically ascending for equal lengths, and join them with "-". Return a single string.
